beats.text: Hello. I'm Dracula. I volunteer here on Tuesdays. The goats know me. I know the goats.
Last week I organized the hay by softness. The rabbits approved. I cried a little. In a good way.
Kindness is a muscle. I exercise it daily. Six hundred years of reps. I'm very toned emotionally.
The new goat looked at me with its little goat throat and I felt..., ...famished. I said 'bless you.' It sneezed. I almost didn't let it stop.
We put me in group therapy. The other members are a werewolf who's afraid of squirrels and a ghost who's scared of quiet. We're doing great.
The goat sends me postcards now. From the other side of the fence. It knows what I almost am. It forgives me anyway. Goats are better than people.

identity_gap.axis_1_baseline: gentle volunteer count (believed, sincere, 600yrs of practice)
identity_gap.axis_2_leak: ancient blood urge (old friend, not defeated — retiring)
identity_gap.why_funny_before_speaking: kind+monster coexisting is comic as pure identity; every mundane act (soup, goats, hay) becomes a collision for free

techniques_as_amplifiers.garden_path: sweet sentences set the expectation the urge breaks
